name: Kusta Qalyee [Calcined stannum]
pharmacology_description: This is a unique unani medicine, prepared with the valuable natural ingredients, which is highly effective in the treatment of spermatorrhoea, oligospermia and premature ejaculation. It is also effective in leucorrhoea.
dosage_description: 1-2 tablet(s) 1-2 time(s) daily or as prescribed by the physician.
side_effects_description: No significant side effect has been observed in proper dosage.
precautions_description: Keep out of reach of the children.
storage_conditions_description: Protect from light. Keep in cool & dry place. Shake well before use.
